drawing: Double bed for a 1600×2000 base; dimension lines on the iso thumbnail (p3): 1778 wide (headboard), 1070 high (headboard), 2058 overall length. Headboard 1 (1778×1070) stands on the floor on 4 plastic glides G; footboard 2 (1662×322) on 3 glides G (2×H 3x12 each). Side rails 3/4 (2008×220) run between headboard and footboard, above the floor (no glides): rail ends butt against the inner face of the headboard, fixed by 2 Direkta 7x70 (B) each driven through the headboard from behind (caps C, step 3); the footboard 2 fits between the rail ends, joined with 4 metal corner brackets E (7 screws F 4x25 each, step 2). Upholstered panel 5 (1678×450, quilted 12 × 3 grid of squares) is screwed onto the bed side of the headboard from behind with 8 screws 4x40 (I), set 50 mm from the top edge and 50 mm from each side edge (step 4: 1778 − 2·50 = 1678). Mattress base A (1600×2000, metal frame with slats and its own legs) is a lettered kit item, not a numbered part; it sits inside the rails. No orthographic front view (p1/p3 iso).
